question: The direction of the induced current when the conductor is moving in the region of magnetic field is given by:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Fleming's right-hand rule**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Fleming right-hand thumb rule:

 
 
• The direction of the induced current is obtained by **Fleming's right-hand rule.**
 
• Fleming's right-hand rule (for generators) shows the direction of induced current when a conductor attached to a circuit moves in a magnetic field.
 
 
 
• The** thumb **is pointed in the direction of the motion of the conductor relative to the magnetic field.
